groups.blurb: Cases and housings milled from plate stock

designs.title: ESP32 remote shell
designs.description: Remote-control bottom shell for ESP32 + OLED + LoRa + keypad + 9V + SD, cut from 220x120x12 steel. Blind pockets only — the mill holds the stock by vacuum, so through-cuts would break it loose.

designs.title: OnePlus 7 Pro case
designs.description: Phone case built from stacked plates with camera and port cutouts.

designs.title: autonomIQ satellite panel
designs.description: Satellite side panel carrying the official autonomIQ lockup on a raised plaque, with 14 mm triangle rows and scalloped edges. The largest tree here at 97 features.

designs.title: autonomIQ showcase plate
designs.description: 208x108x10 stealth octagon with terraced tiers rising to the official lockup — built to test SimplyMill end to end.

designs.title: Satellite side panel (early)
designs.description: The earlier side-panel layout, before the lockup plaque and scallops went on.

designs.title: Porsche cam covers (pair)
designs.description: Both flat-six camshaft covers — billet finned upper and cast ribbed lower — as a 1:3.1 relief on one steel blank. Plan view is true to the real part; height never could be, so it became a relief.

designs.title: Cam cover — upper
designs.description: The billet finned cover as its own part at 1:2.19, outline cut to the cover silhouette.

designs.title: Cam cover — lower
designs.description: The cast ribbed cover, the matching half of the pair.

designs.title: Rocky keychain
designs.description: Traced from a PNG: the figure and a raised rim above a recessed field, with ROCKY / BALBOA engraved as channels into the floor.

designs.title: Spider-man logo
designs.description: Traced logo turned into a milled relief.

groups.blurb: Parts for the 220x120x12 vacuum-held steel stock

designs.title: Isogrid panel
designs.description: Triangular isogrid stiffening pockets — the design that actually suits a vacuum table, since every pocket has a solid floor.

designs.title: Wing rib
designs.description: Lightening holes and flanged cutouts in a classic rib profile.

designs.title: X-frame bracket
designs.description: Cross-braced structural frame with pocketed webs.

designs.title: Fan disk
designs.description: Bladed disk built from a polar pattern.

groups.blurb: A four-part 2.5D demo pump for a 3-axis mill

designs.title: Pump housing
designs.description: Volute, channel and sump cut into one block, with a 1 mm gasket recess around the whole cavity and flat motor counterbores.

designs.title: Pump impeller
designs.description: Six backswept blades (30 to 50 degrees) on a hub, tapered from a rounded nose to sharp inlet and outlet edges, Ø3 press-fit bore.

designs.title: Pump cover
designs.description: The clamping cover with the axial inlet.

designs.title: Pump gasket
designs.description: A 1.5 mm sheet gasket cut to the exact cavity outline — printable 1:1 as a rubber-cutting template.

groups.blurb: A full gear train, part by part

designs.title: Planetary assembly
designs.description: The whole train placed together: ring, sun, planets, carrier and base — 64 features.

designs.title: Ring gear
designs.description: Internal-tooth ring.

designs.title: Planet gear
designs.description: One planet, patterned into the carrier.

designs.title: Carrier
designs.description: Carrier plate with planet posts.

designs.title: Base plate
designs.description: Mounting base for the train.

groups.blurb: Small pieces, good for a first look at the tree

designs.title: Flange Ø100
designs.description: Disc, centre bore and a six-bolt circle — three features, the smallest complete tree.

designs.title: Hex nut M16
designs.description: Hex plate with a centre hole.

designs.title: Bottle cap 28 mm
designs.description: Revolved cap profile.

designs.title: Water bottle 750 ml
designs.description: A single revolve — the whole bottle from one profile.
